title: The Localization Bridge
facebook_comment_text: Going native with M-Pesa & WhatsApp isn't just a feature, it's a foundation. The real engineering reality? Ensuring transaction idempotency, robust error recovery for intermittent networks, and seamless data reconciliation. 💡 A single integration flaw can cost customer trust & revenue.
